verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents built-in AI features that rename requests, generate structured payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases automatically. That is real in-product delegation, but only for narrow, task-specific actions, not a general assistant you hand open-ended tasks to. The MCP server lets external agents act on Hoppscotch data, which is not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general conversational/agentic assistant inside the product, multi-step task delegation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
